name: Bent Over Cable Pec Flye w Integrated Partials
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Hold the weight up, then lower it slowly.
start_cue.hi: Weight upar pakdo, phir dheere neeche lao.

good.en: Good. You opened your arms wide enough.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne haath kaafi khol diye.

fix.en: Open your arms wider at the bottom.

above.en: Not so wide. Stop when you feel a stretch.
above.hi: Itna zyada nahi. Stretch lage wahan ruko.

below.en: Open wider and feel the stretch across your chest.
below.hi: Aur phailao aur chest par stretch mehsoos karo.

almost.en: Open your arms wider at the bottom.

good.en: Good. Your elbows stayed softly straight.

fix.en: Keep a soft bend in your elbows, do not let them collapse.
fix.hi: Kohni mein halka bend rakho, poora mat modho.

almost.en: Keep a soft bend in your elbows, do not let them collapse.
almost.hi: Kohni mein halka bend rakho, poora mat modho.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the opening. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Kholne mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Control the opening. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Kholne mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

fix.en: One arm is opening less. Move both together.
fix.hi: Ek haath kam khul raha hai. Dono saath kholo.

almost.en: One arm is opening less. Move both together.
almost.hi: Ek haath kam khul raha hai. Dono saath kholo.
